description: Implement Error Normalizer Regex, /v1/report takedown endpoint with timing shield, and Midnight Freeze guard global circuit breaker.
acceptance_criteria: Returns 401 Unauthorized for invalid or missing secret.
Returns 200 JSON success for valid secret.
The 503 response uses standard error JSON envelope.

contract_snippets: export function timingSafeEqualStrings(a: string, b: string): boolean;
context_bundle.implementation_notes: Use regex /(sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|Bearer\s+[a-zA-Z0-9\-\._~+\/]+)/g for secrets and /\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b/g for IPs. Check request headers for 'authorization'. Strip 'Bearer '. Compare securely with `env.REPORT_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. Place the freeze check at the very top of `handle` in `RouterHandler`.
